title: Pancakes
note: 英文人工 SRT 与中文翻译逐条对齐；纯音效/水印行已剔除。

lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother
lines.zh: 我是佩奇。这是我的小弟弟

lines.en: George, this is Mummy Pig and this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Peppa Pig.
Pancakes.
It is tea time and Mummy Pig has a surprise for everyone.
lines.zh: 下午茶时间到了，猪妈妈给大家带来了惊喜。

lines.en: Today is a day for pancakes.
Pancakes. Delicious.
I love pancakes.
Everyone loves pancakes.
I'm the expert at flipping the pancakes over. Leave that to me.
lines.zh: 我是翻煎饼的专家。交给我吧。

lines.en: Are you sure, Daddy Pig? Last time you got a bit
lines.zh: 你确定吗，猪爸爸？上次你有一点

lines.en: grumpy when you dropped the pancake on the floor.
lines.zh: 当你把煎饼掉在地板上时脾气暴躁。

lines.en: I did not get grumpy. There was a problem with the frying pan.
lines.zh: 我没有脾气暴躁。煎锅有问题。

lines.en: Mummy, can we help make the pancakes, please?
lines.zh: 妈妈，我们可以帮忙做煎饼吗？

lines.en: Yes, you can help me make the batter.
lines.zh: 是的，你可以帮我做面糊。

lines.en: First I put some flour in the bowl.
lines.zh: 首先我在碗里放了一些面粉。

lines.en: Now I add an egg.
Now the milk.
And I give it all a stir.
Mummy, can I stir?
lines.zh: 妈妈，我可以搅拌一下吗？

lines.en: Yes, of course, Peppa.
Peppa loves stirring.
George wants to stir as well.
No, George, like this.
OK, that's enough stirring.
You two sit at the table while I cook the pancakes.
lines.zh: 我做煎饼的时候你们两个坐在桌边。

lines.en: Mummy Pig is going to flip the pancake over.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈要把煎饼翻过来。

lines.en: Hooray!
You could flip it higher, Mummy Pig.
lines.zh: 你可以把它调高一点，猪妈妈。

lines.en: You can show us how when you flip your own pancake, Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸，你可以向我们展示你自己翻煎饼的方法。

lines.en: This first pancake is for George.
lines.zh: 这第一块煎饼是给乔治的。

lines.en: Mummy Pig pours a little syrup on George's pancake.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈在乔治的煎饼上倒了一点糖浆。

lines.en: Delicious.
This pancake is for Peppa.
Hooray!
You could flip it higher, Mummy Pig.
lines.zh: 你可以把它翻高一点，猪妈妈。

lines.en: You will get a chance to show me when you flip your own pancake, Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸，你自己翻煎饼的时候就有机会给我看。

lines.en: Syrup, please.
Mmm, delicious.
This pancake is for Mummy Pig.
lines.zh: 这个煎饼是给猪妈妈的。

lines.en: Hooray!
You still aren't flipping them high enough, Mummy Pig.
lines.zh: 你还是把它们弹得不够高，猪妈妈。

lines.en: The next pancake is yours, Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 下一个煎饼就是你的了，猪爸爸。

lines.en: So now you can show us how it should be done.
lines.zh: 现在您可以向我们展示应该如何完成。

lines.en: Mmm, delicious.
Is everyone watching?
The secret of making a good pancake is to flip it high into the air.
lines.zh: 做好煎饼的秘诀就是把它高高地翻转到空中。

lines.en: A-one, two, three, whoop-la!
Silly Daddy.
Oh, maybe that was just a bit too high.
Oh, what a shame. That was the last pancake.
lines.zh: 噢，真可惜。那是最后一块煎饼。

lines.en: It should be a simple matter to get it down.
lines.zh: 记下来应该是一件简单的事情。

lines.en: Oh dear, Daddy Pig cannot reach his pancake.
lines.zh: 天啊，猪爸爸够不到他的煎饼了。

lines.en: Don't worry, Daddy Pig. I think I know a way to get it down.
lines.zh: 别担心，猪爸爸。我想我知道有办法把它放下来。

lines.en: Let's go upstairs, children.
This way.
What is Mummy Pig planning to do?
On the count of three, we all have to start jumping up and down.
lines.zh: 数到三，我们都得开始上蹿下跳。

lines.en: One, two, three, jump!
What are they doing?
It worked. Now Daddy Pig has his pancake.
lines.zh: 成功了。现在猪爸爸有他的煎饼了。

lines.en: Daddy has a pancake on his head.
lines.zh: 爸爸头上顶着一块煎饼。

lines.en: Oh!
Syrup on your pancake, Daddy Pig?
lines.zh: 你的煎饼上有糖浆吗，猪爸爸？

lines.en: Yes, please.
One, two, three, whoop-la!
Delicious.
Silly Daddy.
I want to be a nurse.
I want to be a doctor.
But who's going to be the sick person?
